    df = np.count_nonzero(counts > 0, axis=0)

    # Ensure no zero degrees (should not happen if graph is connected? but check)

    # L_norm @ v = v - D^{-1/2} @ X @ (X.T @ (D^{-1/2} @ v)) + D^{-1} @ v
